identity.title: Liquid transfer with a manual pipette

semantics.purpose: Move a stated volume from a source liquid to a destination container with a piston-stroke pipette and disposable tip.
preconditions: A clean compatible tip is attached and the requested volume is within the fitted pipette range.
The source contains at least the requested volume and the destination has headroom.
The transfer mode is confirmed before execution.

outputs.description: Remaining source after a partial transfer; identity is preserved but volume is reduced.

sample_transitions.note: Only the remaining source is represented here; the transferred portion is a separate transition.
Source loses the transferred volume; destination gains a new sample portion. No concentration change is implied.
The sample identity moves to the destination container; no separate source remainder is asserted.
Source liquid is added to existing destination content; the destination state changes.

parameters.label: Transfer relationship
parameters.description: Selects which conditional sample transition applies; this is not a default.

evidence.locator: Aspirate, Dispense, Blow out, Mix, Air gap

parameters.label: Transfer volume
parameters.description: Positive volume; actual limits come from the selected pipette profile, tip and liquid, not from this generic operation.

evidence.locator: Aspirate, Dispense, Blow out, Mix, Air gap

completion_checks.description: A clean tip is attached before aspiration.
The recorded delivered volume matches the requested volume within the pipette tolerance.

decision_points.question: Is the requested volume within the fitted pipette and tip range?
decision_points.evidence: Instrument profile volume range and tip specification.
decision_points.continue_if: The requested volume is within both ranges.
decision_points.stop_if: The volume is outside the fitted range or the tip is incompatible.

decision_points.question: Which transfer relationship applies: partial, add-to-existing or full?
decision_points.continue_if: The relationship is explicit and conditional transitions are selected.
decision_points.stop_if: The relationship is still unknown; keep the transition Unresolved.

failure_modes.action: Replace the tip and repeat the affected transfer; record the deviation.

failure_modes.symptom: Delivered volume differs from the requested volume beyond tolerance.
failure_modes.action: Check tip fit, liquid class, pre-wetting and pipette calibration; repeat with a verified pipette.
